# slack-web-api-mcp — install (generated by anymcp)

```bash
npm i @modelcontextprotocol/sdk zod
SLACK_WEB_API_TOKEN=your_token  node --loader tsx server.ts
```

mcp.json (local / stdio):
```json
{ "mcpServers": { "slack-web-api": { "command": "node", "args": ["--loader","tsx","/path/to/server.ts"], "env": { "SLACK_WEB_API_TOKEN": "your_token" } } } }
```

Remote / hosted (Streamable HTTP) — agent connects to a URL instead of launching a process:
```bash
MCP_TRANSPORT=http PORT=3000 SLACK_WEB_API_TOKEN=your_token  node --loader tsx server.ts
# → POST http://<host>:3000/mcp   (stateless; single-tenant: token from env)
```
